sources.citation: RAVEL authored premises and conventions; license: Apache-2.0. External primary references are locator-only in each registry row.

nodes.statement: Four-flavour and five-flavour descriptions allocate heavy-quark contributions differently. Their PDFs, matrix elements, masses and matching prescriptions must form a consistent perturbative prediction.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:flavour-scheme; primary references: arXiv:1405.0301, event generation and matching

obligations.description: Record the flavour scheme, PDF set and version, perturbative order, heavy-quark treatment and any matching prescription.

nodes.statement: A total DECAY width does not supply branching fractions or decay channels to a shower. Model, restriction and shower import settings determine which masses and decays are used.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:decay-tables; primary references: arXiv:1410.3012, particle data, showers, matching and merging; arXiv:1108.2040, model conventions and coupling orders

obligations.description: Inspect the exported particle masses, widths, channel tables and actual shower import settings before accepting the decay chain.

nodes.statement: A resonance mass-window cutoff truncates sampled phase space. Matrix-element/parton-shower merging scales and generation cuts also change support and require validation in the requested observable.
nodes.applicability: Review this convention in the stated process, observable, phase-space domain and perturbative order; retrieval does not establish applicability.

evidence.locator: RAVEL authored convention conv:generation-support; primary references: arXiv:1405.0301, event generation and matching; arXiv:1206.4803, off-shell effects and signal-background interference

obligations.description: Record mass-window and merging settings; test support, tails and matching against the requested accuracy.
